# Komo E.G.C Inc.

> Komo E.G.C Inc. is an ECRA/ESA-licensed electrical contractor (licence #7015083) based in Windsor, Ontario, Canada. It sub-contracts to general contractors and works for business owners and homeowners across Essex County: Windsor, Tecumseh, LaSalle, Lakeshore, Amherstburg and Essex. Phone 647-767-7815.

Key facts:
- Legal name: Komo E.G.C Inc.
- ECRA/ESA Electrical Contractor Licence: #7015083 (verify: https://findacontractor.esasafe.com/Home/ContractorSearch)
- Voltage classes: 120/240V single-phase, 120/208V and 347/600V three-phase
- Files ESA notifications under its own licence, books inspections, hands over the Certificate of Acceptance
- Provides WSIB clearance and a certificate of insurance before mobilization
- Incorporated 2019

## Services
- [Commercial Tenant Fit-Outs](https://komoelectrical.ca/services/commercial-tenant-fit-outs/): Shell to finished electrical for retail, office and plaza units. System: 120/208V 3Ø · 120/240V 1Ø.
- [600V Three-Phase Power](https://komoelectrical.ca/services/600v-three-phase-power/): 347/600V services, distribution, transformers and feeders. System: 347/600V 3Ø · 120/208V 3Ø.
- [Restaurant & Kitchen Electrical](https://komoelectrical.ca/services/restaurant-kitchen-electrical/): Hood control panels, equipment circuits and dining-room lighting. System: 120/208V 3Ø.
- [Warehouse LED Lighting Retrofits](https://komoelectrical.ca/services/warehouse-led-lighting-retrofits/): High-bay LED replacements and lighting controls. System: 347V · 120V lighting circuits.
- [Machine Hookups & Motor Controls](https://komoelectrical.ca/services/machine-hookups-motor-controls/): Equipment feeds, disconnects, motor controls and VFDs. System: 600V 3Ø · 208V 3Ø.
- [Panel & Service Upgrades](https://komoelectrical.ca/services/panel-service-upgrades/): Commercial panel work and residential 100A to 200A upgrades. System: 120/240V 1Ø · 120/208V 3Ø · 600V.
- [Generators & Transfer Switches](https://komoelectrical.ca/services/generators-transfer-switches/): Standby generator connections and transfer switches. System: 120/240V · 120/208V · 600V.
